title: Trump says US-South Korea exercises are 'insulting' to North Korea's Kim
script: Here is what viewers need to know right now. The key update now being reported is: Trump says US-South Korea exercises are 'insulting' to North Korea's Kim. In simple words, Trump said the U.S. is scaling back the exercises and that he'll meet with Kim Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update. We will continue watching for clearer and more reliable updates.
